summary: This is an 8-K filed by Starlink AI Acquisition Corp, a blank-check SPAC, reporting the closing of its IPO of 10M units at $10/unit for $100M gross proceeds, simultaneous private placement of 221,500 sponsor units for $2.215M, and a partial over-allotment exercise of 500K units for $5M with an additional 4,750 private units. The $100.5M is placed in trust. This is a standard SPAC IPO formation filing, not an event-based special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation trigger is present.
